result.coreMessage: You are not the only one waiting for the bag on Monday; neighbours and colleagues brew the same coffee and start the week together.
result.hook: Samme mandag. Samme kaffe som naboen.
result.hookEn: Same Monday. Same coffee as your neighbour.
result.visualDirection: Candid phone photo by an open front door in soft morning light, woman in cardigan and wool socks picking up a plain unlabelled coffee bag, two steaming cups on the wooden floor beside her, neighbour doorway softly blurred behind, warm autumn daylight, slightly tilted framing, no letters, text, logos or signage visible.
result.primaryTextDa: Mandag morgen banker posen på døren, med ristedato på posen. Naboen får sin i dag. Kollegaen også. I brygger hver for sig, men starter ugen sammen. Et Home-abonnement, der følger din rytme. Spring en uge over, når du vil.
result.primaryTextEn: Monday morning the bag knocks on the door, with roast date on the bag. Your neighbour gets hers today. Your colleague too. You brew apart, but you start the week together. A Home plan that follows your rhythm. Skip a week when you like.
